text:
dana: FYI I opened a PR to fix /v1/generate examples 94 the API ref currently uses 'choices' in the JSON responses but the runtime returns 'candidates' (array) for multi-hypothesis outputs. This mismatch is causing downstream SDK parsers to break. PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5011 

kevin: oof. where did 'choices' come from? we used 'choices' in an older draft; the runtime team switched to 'candidates' to avoid confusion with chat 'choices'. paste the bad snippet?

 dana: current example shows:
```json
{
  "id": "gen_abc",
  "object": "generation",
  "choices": [{ "text": "hi" }]
}
```
but actual runtime returns:
```json
{
  "id": "gen_abc",
  "object": "generation",
  "candidates": [{ "text": "hi", "score": 0.92 }]
}
```
Also the docs don't mention that streaming SSE sends partial candidate deltas under `event: candidate.delta` and that the final object uses `candidates` not `choices`.

marta: nice catch. can you update the OpenAPI response schema to have `candidates` and add an example showing score and index? Also update the JS/py snippet generator to emit `candidates` for non-chat generate endpoints.

lucy: heads-up 94 the linter already flagged mismatch: components.schemas.GenerationResponse.properties.choices unknown, expected candidates. CI: https://ci.redwood-inference/1722/logs/88 :warning:

 dana: i've pushed a YAML diff that replaces choices with candidates and added a streaming example. I also changed the example generator so ./scripts/gen-snippets uses the `responseKeyFor('generate')` hook rather than the old alias.

kevin: two asks: 1) add a short migration note in the API ref for users who parsed `choices` already; show a one-liner JS helper `const primary = resp.candidates?.[0] ?? resp.choices?.[0];` 2) ensure SSE example includes the `Content-Type: text/event-stream` header and shows `event: candidate.delta` frames  customers were pasting the SSE example into non-streaming clients and seeing weird JSON.

raj: support reports a customer broke because their Go SDK unmarshalled into struct with `Choices []Choice` causing a panic. we should add an SDK compatibility snippet and file an SDK sweep issue. i'll open a ticket in sdk repo.

 docs-bot: lint error when PR used choices: components.schemas.GenerationResponse.example had unexpected `choices` key. Fix required. https://ci.redwood-inference/1722/builds/89 :x:

marta: before merging, please add a docs-test that fetches the generated HTML page and asserts it contains `"candidates": [` and `event: candidate.delta` in the streaming section. Also add a short example showing the final response body with `candidates` and explain `index` semantics.

 dana: added tests and updated the generated JS snippet to prefer `candidates`. pushed changes.

 docs-bot: CI re-run passed on branch fix/generate-candidates (build 501) :white_check_mark: https://ci.redwood-inference/1722/builds/501

kevin: merged. raj please follow up with an SDK sweep issue and tag eng-runtime so they can confirm the exact response shape and any legacy aliases.

raj: filed https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/917 with examples for Go/Python/JS. pinged eng-runtime for confirmation.

lucy: small follow-up: update the changelog entry for this week noting the API ref clarified generate response key change, and mention that runtime maintains a short alias mapping for one release (`choices` -> `candidates`) but we encourage switching ASAP.

dana: thanks all 94 closing the PR and this thread once the SDK sweep is tracked. :tada:
